name: Phase 1 watchlist
notes: Real tickers, mega-cap names off the personal watchlist. Two broad-market benchmarks sit at the top, ahead of the single names, because they are reference points rather than positions: Phase 1 requires both and a test asserts they are present, so edit the rest freely but leave SPY and QQQ alone. After the seven tech names come two reads that tech alone cannot give you -- JPM for rates and credit, XLE for where geopolitics reaches a price first. Commodities and crypto stay held back for now: separate market-analyst path, tracked on a different branch, not merged into Phase 1. Kept ASCII-only on purpose -- this file has been broken once already by typographic quotes pasted from an editor that autocorrects them.
